problems: khoshut-khanate books Central Tibet as its own gain in 1642 (counterpart 'tsangpa-dynasty', which is this state, not a separate one) and dzungar-khanate books it as a gain in 1717; the pages (Ganden Phodrang infobox, Khoshut Khanate) call Tibet a Khoshut protectorate to 1717 and then Qing protectorate from 1720, so those two ledgers should become vassal events (counterpart 'tibet') and the Dzungar years an occupation, or Tibet is painted three times.

qing-dynasty (ea-08) should carry vassal_start 1720 / vassal_end 1912 with counterpart 'tibet' and the occupations of Lhasa 1910-1912 and western Kham 1905-1918 (this dossier books the owner's side of those occupations); the PRC dossier the 1951-1959 protectorate (Ganden Phodrang infobox).

Cliopatria's Tibet row (1363-1952) is reviewed as the state 1354-1951: it starts nine years early (new keyframe 1354-1362, overlapping the Cliopatria Yuan Dynasty row) and ends 23 May 1951; shapes 1363-1636 are cut from the whole plateau to Central Tibet (ratio 0.71); 1932-1950 shapes are wrong (Chamdo omitted); 1918-1927 overshoot the Yangtze.

Cliopatria has no Tibet shape for 1794-1911 although its Qing shape contains 4,300 of the 4,342 Central Tibet cells; the dossier adds tibet_1794 (1775 frontier) as a Qing protectorate keyframe. How to draw a protectorate that sits inside the suzerain's own shape is a rendering decision.

WebFetch returns quotes capped near 125 characters, so several quotes in notes are fragments of the page's sentences; one is marked as a paraphrase. Fourteen pages were opened, the whole budget; no page failed to load.
The 1913 independence proclamation is recorded as a rename event only because no event type fits a change of status without a change of name.
